source_runs.use: The completed epoch count determines five spaced capture epochs in the final 20% of each scorer trajectory.

data.label_access: Training and validation labels only; all remaining labels are replaced by -1 before scorer replay or classifier retraining.

common_structure.budget: K=max(1,floor(rho*t)) over the t original observed incidences
common_structure.fixed_self_loops: One fixed singleton self-loop per node, excluded from K, for every mask family.
common_structure.deployment: Binary exact-K subhypergraph with unit retained-incidence weights.

scorer_replay.stopping: Replay each source trajectory for its completed epoch count.

mask_generation.late_family: Five deterministic top-K masks from the specified scorer epochs.
mask_generation.temporal_core: Intersection of the five late masks within one dataset-budget-source-seed trajectory.
mask_generation.unstable_boundary: Union of the five late masks minus their intersection.
mask_generation.boundary_family: Preserve the temporal core and uniformly sample the remaining K-|core| positions without replacement from the unstable boundary.

classifier_retraining.rule: Discard the discovery classifier, freeze each binary mask, and train a new common HGNN from scratch.
classifier_retraining.paired_initialization: Every mask in a dataset-budget cell receives the same parameter initialization and dropout random stream.
classifier_retraining.primary_metric: validation accuracy at the minimum-validation-loss checkpoint

interpretation.late_mask_evidence: A pair is descriptively equivalent and materially different when its Jaccard is at most 0.95 and its absolute validation-accuracy difference is at most 0.5 percentage points.
interpretation.boundary_evidence: Boundary interchangeability is supported in a cell when the source-seed mean Boundary-minus-Late difference has magnitude at most 0.5 points.
interpretation.limitations: Masks and epochs within a source trajectory are dependent. Three source seeds do not support a statistical-significance claim; report descriptive intervals and all cells.

required_audits: exact K original incidences in every mask
fixed self-loops excluded from K for every family
test labels redacted before any training
identical classifier initialization within each dataset-budget cell
fresh classifier for every fixed mask
boundary masks contain the full temporal core and no incidence outside the late-mask union
all 360 evaluation records present before aggregation
reporting_rule: Report all 12 dataset-budget cells, including negative and null outcomes. Do not select masks, datasets, budgets, seeds, or epochs after observing validation accuracy.

resource_policy.resume_policy: Completed collection bundles and evaluation records with matching specification hashes may be reused.
